Strommast

An elevated travel point linked to other towers by wires.

Aktivitäten

Search crates and barrels on the platform, then ride the wire like a zipline.

Ertrag

Platform containers hold loot, and the line crosses forests and hills.

Risiken

You are exposed and easy to spot while riding; this is not a player-built watchtower.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
